theorems.name: Submission.deformation_dilation_mass
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, (∀ ω η : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k, (∀ x, (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k) x = ρ ^ k • (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl N) k) (ρ • x)) → Y ω = X η) → Y.mass = ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ k) * X.mass
